thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread to finalize minimal acceptance criteria for Optimize recommendations pilot (batching/caching/quant). Goal: keep it simple and customer-friendly.

sam - Eng: Tech constraints: start with int8 only. Runtime will emit rec_metadata (quant_profile, batch_hint, cache_hint) so we can join telemetry.

li - ML: Quality gating: use per-customer canonical eval set + sampled live A/B. If concordance drops > 2% OR live mismatch > 1% -> auto-pause.

maria - Solutions: Customers want an "explain" snippet and opt-out. We'll provide a one-page FAQ and an "why this was chosen" payload.

eng-obs: Dashboard plan: per-recommendation card with tokens saved, p95 latency delta, concordance trend, and a rollback action.

devops-bot: deploy 1758012480 started -> canary to optimize-pilot pool

anya - PM: Draft launch criteria:
- concordance delta <= 1.5% vs baseline on canonical set
- token cost reduction >= 7% median for pilot traffic
- error rate increase <= 0.1% over 24h
- rollback automation validated in staging

sam - Eng: Also add a sample-level suppression: if token perplexity spike observed, suppress quant rec for that route.

li - ML: We'll wire eval hooks to trigger alerts and a small A/B harness for downstream KPI checks (customer-provided proxies).

maria - Solutions: I'll recruit 3 pilot customers and prepare comms. Recommend AcmeHealth, ComposeAI, TutorLabs.

anya - PM: Owners & dates: maria pilot outreach by Tue, sam runtime tags + canary by Fri, li eval hook prototype by Fri, eng-obs dashboard stub by Mon. Reconvene Wed 11am to review readiness. :thumbsup:
